response.sql: SELECT s.entrystat AS entrystat, AVG(e.ambictemp) AS avg_ambictemp, AVG(e.imgcount) AS avg_imgcount, AVG(e.imgcount) - (SELECT AVG(e2.imgcount) FROM scanenvironment e2 JOIN sites s2 ON e2.zoneref = s2.zoneregistry) AS diff_from_overall_avg_imgcount FROM scanenvironment e JOIN sites s ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.entrystat
